Description: SWE-bench Verified evaluates software engineering agents by asking them to fix real issues in open-source Python repositories and submit a patch that passes the project’s tests. The “Verified” subset contains tasks that have been human-validated as solvable and unambiguous, emphasizing end-to-end debugging and code changes rather than standalone algorithmic coding.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension (minor), Language Production (minor)
L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory, Semantic Understanding & Context Recognition, Decision-making (minor), Attention (minor)
L3:

Description: SWE-bench Multilingual extends SWE-bench-style patch generation to multiple programming languages, requiring models to understand diverse ecosystems, tooling, and language-specific idioms. It measures whether an agent can localize a bug, modify the right files, and produce a correct patch across languages beyond Python.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension, Language Production (minor)
L2: Semantic Understanding & Context Recognition, Logical Reasoning, Planning, Working Memory, Decision-making (minor)
L3: Cognitive Flexibility (minor)

Description: SWE-bench Pro is a larger, more challenging software engineering benchmark emphasizing realism, diversity, and contamination resistance, with tasks spanning multiple languages and more complex repos. It tests whether agents can reliably execute multi-step debugging, implement fixes, and satisfy project tests under more industrially representative conditions.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension (minor), Language Production (minor)
L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory, Semantic Understanding & Context Recognition, Decision-making (minor), Attention (minor)
L3: Cognitive Flexibility (minor)

Description: Terminal-Bench 2.0 evaluates agents performing real command-line tasks (e.g., repo manipulation, debugging, system operations) using a terminal toolchain and an agent harness. Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension (minor)
L2: Planning, Decision-making, Working Memory, Logical Reasoning, Attention (minor)
L3: Inhibitory Control (minor)

Cognitive Functions:
